name: List
description: Repeat the `item` template for every row of `items` (bind to `$data.<source>` or a state list), as a stack or a grid. Inside the template use `$item.<field>`.

items.description: Rows to repeat over. A plain object is repeated over its entries instead, each arriving as { key, value } (a row-shaped value is spread, keeping its key).

empty.description: Text shown when there are no items

filterKey.description: Keep rows whose field equals filterValue (bind filterValue to state; empty = all)

groupBy.description: Group rows by this key: the item template then repeats per group and gets { value, count, rows }, so a nested List over `$item.rows` renders one group.

groupOrder.description: Groups that come first, in this order.

filterIn.description: Keep rows whose filterKey is in this set: a list, or the { value: boolean } map a checkbox group or an IconBar emits. An empty selection keeps all.

exclude.description: Rows to subtract: keep only those whose excludeBy field appears in none of them, e.g. the registrations that are not already accounts.

excludeBy.description: Field compared on both sides of exclude; dotted paths allowed.

near.description: Sort nearest-first from this [lon, lat] and give the item template a `distanceKm`. Bind the state `watchLocation` fills.

coordinatesKey.description: Where a row keeps its position (default "coordinates"); a dotted path works.

coordinates.description: What those numbers are (default "lonlat"); map features are usually "webmercator".
